mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month acceleration in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) above trend signals stronger household demand, which raises earnings expectations and boosts S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth > 0.4% MoM for two consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during triggered episodes (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the unemployment rate below 4% signals labor market overheating, which raises wage growth and inflation, ultimately reducing forward equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 4% and remains there for 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during triggered episodes (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) below trend signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces earnings growth and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls below trend for two consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during triggered episodes (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in real retail sales (RSAFS) below trend signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS falls below trend for three consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during triggered episodes (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a restrictive monetary policy stance, which raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during triggered episodes (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the unemployment rate below 4% combined with a 3-month acceleration in average hourly earnings (HOUST) above trend signals labor market overheating, which raises wage growth and inflation, ultimately reducing forward equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 4% and HOUST rises above trend for three consecutive months
regime_hint: tight labor market with rising wages
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during triggered episodes (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) above trend combined with a 3-month decline in real retail sales (RSAFS) below trend signals mixed demand signals, which reduces earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 rises above trend for three consecutive months and RSAFS falls below trend for three consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during triggered episodes (t-test p > 0.05).
